b: All this time telling the story, I haven't introduced the characters.. Best to do it now.. Otherwise the story won't make sense..

First is Mithra, also known as Mithu.. The story of her name is a long one.. I'll give you her mail ID.. Ask her yourselves.. We got to know each other in campus days as my friend's friend.. Terribly clever.. But you'd never know by looking.. In campus days and now too, if you've nowhere to go, you can boldly go to her place.. There's always something in the fridge.. Since she's the one who made this plan, she'll turn up in a lot of places in the story.. Almost like the heroine.. Don't think too much of it though.. She'll come and go for comic relief, like Kovai Sarala in the film Sathi Leelavathi

Next, Dhanush..my friend's boyfriend.. That's how I know him too.. I've already written a lot about him in the earlier chapters.. If I write more I'll get scolded by Rami.. Rami's a nice girl too (this is a paid advertisement)

Sing Keeth.. If you're reading this story, you're most likely his Instagram friend. If you're a female reader, you definitely are.. Go and have a look.. He's terribly clever too.. We go back to A-Level days.. He's a Singaporean now, doing a PhD.. If you're talking style, terrific style..+ style + style (he told me to pump up the style a bit… so there.. he's pretty much the rowdy type too; footnote: "style" here is the word the young generation uses a lot now. It means "I'm a big shot"… this is for our readers of the older generation)
Fourth, Thushara..though I knew her before, only now did I get the chance to get to know her.. A good friend to both Dhanush and Sing Keeth…she gives sensible, thoughtful opinions..
Now, of these, Mithra, Sing Keeth and Thushara had already gone to Vietnam on Saturday.. We land only on Sunday morning.. We have to talk to them before going to the hotel
Now back to the story.. When I switch on roaming, nothing comes through.. It shows signal.. but no calls go through .. And the ones who'd gone already had told us there's no Wi-Fi at the airport

Wondering what to do, we went in, and right at the entrance they were selling SIMs.. There was a place to change money too.. But we didn't know which SIM would work everywhere.. Apparently Sing Keeth had told Dhanush some name.. He'd heard it and forgotten

On a blind hunch I asked the shop lady if she could give us Wi-Fi, she understood English and set up the airport Wi-Fi on my phone; scolding the guy who'd confused us without knowing this, we called and talked to them.. Then we changed money, got SIMs and hurried out.. Because any minute now our mealtime would be over.. We had to go before that
note: Kovai Sarala is a Tamil comic actress; Sathi Leelavathi (1995) is one of her best-known films. In the original, the word for "style" is the youth slang "gethu". Pettah is Colombo's crowded bazaar district. "Clerking" is the medical students' term for taking a patient's history.
